summary: The episode analyzes the aftermath of the SEC lawsuit against Binance, which caused significant market weakness. BTC and ETH both showing failed breakdown structures with lower highs and lower lows. The host recommends waiting for one of three bullish signals: failed breakdown (spike in reverse), hitting support (22-24k for BTC), or reclaiming broken ranges. Altcoins are particularly vulnerable.
